title: Golden and Clear Creek Scenic Ebike Tour
includes: Panniers (1 small bag on top and one on side, like a backpack to put items into)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This 18-mile loop is a fun and breezy ride through the foothills and heart of Golden. You'll cruise through quiet neighborhoods, take in stunning views from Lookout Mountain, and follow Clear Creek past kayakers and historic landmarks.

Along the way, we share stories about Golden’s mining roots, colorful characters like Buffalo Bill, and how this small town helped shape Colorado’s wild west history. It’s an easygoing ride full of local flavor, hidden corners, and scenic surprises — perfect for anyone who wants to explore more with less effort.
